ratings.note: Every day change shows a blank slot area for ~900 ms (probes 3, 15); harm is a brief uncertainty or a repeat tap, under a second. Below s=3 because the gap is short and slots then appear without user action.
Van/trailer bookings with a bad permit only; plain-text error with no link on a page without the field (probe 27) makes recovery hard but Change vehicle exists and keeps details. Matches s=2.
Only cancelled bookings (made more likely by the double-press defect); page headed 'Booked' with gate text can mislead a resident at the gate into a wasted trip and turn-away. Matches s=3.
Desktop at wide widths only; grid stops at ~816 px vs 1184 px cards (screenshot). Visual unevenness, no task effect. Matches s=1.
Van users who mistype the permit; message says a permit is needed while summary shows 'permit 12345' (probe 60), misdiagnosing the error and inviting the same wrong entry. Matches s=2.
Phone users using 'Another day'; numeric keypad lacks '/' while hint shows slashes, but 8 digits are accepted. Hesitation with workaround. Matches s=2.
Every use of Change slot / Back resets to Today with no selection (probes 10, 18); a resident can rebook on the wrong day with only the Day row showing it. Matches s=3.
Residents whose plans change after booking (declared group); only route is a weekday phone call, i.e. a support contact, and impossible evenings/weekends. Matches s=3.
Van/trailer owners without a permit; info panel names the council site with no link (aria), so they must search elsewhere; the two-day wait is the real block, not the missing link. Matches s=2.
Today is the default day and same-day booking is common; past slots look free and fail only after vehicle and details are filled (probe 75). Matches s=3.

Every car booking sees the permit field with no 'vans only' wording (probe 28), but the booking proceeds with it empty; hesitation only. Below s=3 because no error or block results and the DRC- hint signals a special case.
Only on expired holds; first error is a dead-end text item with recovery via the small Change slot link (aria, probe 67). Matches s=2.
Only a Next press within 900 ms of a day change; the press is dropped silently and a second press works. Matches s=1.
Interrupted phone use is the declared scene, so exceeding 5 min is common; the slot lapses with no warning or extension (probe p-wait), costing a scarce slot. Matches s=3.
Every booking: 1.2-1.5 s with an unchanged, enabled button (probe 67, p-busy). The uncertainty itself is minor, but it invites the second press that cancels the booking. Matches s=3.
Phones at 360 px or less, common for the mostly-phone audience; third slot column is clipped on the main step (probe 79 screenshot), a reflow failure. Matches s=3.

Double-tap is a common phone habit; a second press within 1.5 s relabels to 'Cancel booking' and silently saves the booking as cancelled (probe 73), so the resident is turned away at the gate. Matches s=4.
Every booking passes the vehicle step without day/slot shown (aria); loss of reassurance only, choice reappears on Check and book. Below s=3 because nothing is blocked or mis-entered.
Keyboard and screen-reader users with vehicle/waste errors; link scrolls but focus lands on the document (probe 74), one extra Tab or swipe search. Matches s=2.

Every confirmation omits day, 20-minute window and vehicle (probes 11, 21); the page is what is shown at the gate, so a wrong arrival time is possible. Below s=4 because the time was just chosen and an SMS reminder is promised.
Van/trailer bookings with missing or bad permit pass the vehicle step (probes 23, 29) and fail only after the full form and wait, on a page without the field. Matches s=3.
Screen-reader users on the vehicle step; waste limits and vehicle error are not announced with the controls (probe 82), though the alert summary still reports errors. Matches s=2.
Van/trailer bookers see only an 'i' glyph for the permit rules (375 screenshot); the visible permit field partly signals the need. Matches s=2.
